QuestInfo.name: [Eluna Express] The Town Savior
QuestInfo.0: You finished your training in Korean Folk Town, but you can hear a voice in the distance. Who could it be?
QuestInfo.1: Chumji of Korean Folk Town expresses his gratitude to the savior who solved so many of their problems... and very humbly requests another favor. You may have finished your training in Korean Folk Town, but it sounds like they could really use the help. Hunt 1,500 more #o5100108# monsters as Chumji requested.
QuestInfo.2: You solved even more problems in Korean Folk Town. The fatigue you feel now was a small price to pay for bringing happiness to others.
